To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The shear zone formation in a granular body is affected by the heterogeneity of the material.
heterogeneity in the form of single spots with a different void ratio leads to a spontaneous formation of a shear zone in granular bodies.

1) heterogeneity in granular materials is the key to triggering the formation of spontaneous shear zones and 2) the shear zones are formed at the boundary between two different types of granular bodies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of heterogeneities on the formation of shear zones inside granular materials.
the effect of the initial void ratio distribution on the formation of the shear zone in granular material.
the effect of the heterogeneity on the shear zone formation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the heterogeneity in the form of randomly or stochatically distributed single spots with different void ratios leads to a more pronounced formation of shear zones in the granular material.
heterogeneity in granular bodies leads to a spontaneous shear zone formation.
heterogeneity in the form of a random distribution of spots of the different void ratios has an essential influence on the development of the shear zone in granular material.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heterogeneity is a necessary condition for the shear zone formation and that the shear zone is a consequence of the heterogeneity in the material.
the shear zone formation is influenced by the heterogeneity in the form of single spots and by its distribution.
the heterogeneity in the form of a single spot with a different initial porosity is sufficient to trigger the shear zone formation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the heterogeneity in the form of a single spot is able to trigger shear zone formation.
the shear zone formation is strongly influenced by the distribution of heterogeneity spots and their sizes, but not by the initial void ratio.
heterogeneity in granular bodies triggers the formation of shear zones.
